observations: Three photos show long, corrugated metal sheets in a workshop or factory setting.
The sheets have a dark gray or black finish with a textured, dimpled surface on the lower part of the corrugations.
The top edges of the sheets appear to be a lighter, metallic silver color, suggesting a dual-tone or two-layer design.
The sheets are laid out in a straight line, extending toward a rolling machine in the background.
The watermark 'CAPITAL ALUMINUM' is visible on all three photos, but it is a digital overlay, not a physical mark on the product.
No visible brand name, model, or specification label is present on the sheets themselves.
The environment appears to be a manufacturing or processing facility, with electrical boxes, cables, and machinery visible.

claims.evidence: The watermark 'CAPITAL ALUMINUM' is present in all photos, but it is a digital overlay and not a physical mark on the product. No physical branding is visible on the sheets.

claims.claim: we deal in all kind of aluminum roofing sheets such as metcopo design aluminum...
claims.evidence: The term 'metcopo design' is not visible in any photo. The profile of the sheet does not clearly match any known 'metcopo' design, and no label or marking confirms this. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the photos.

risks.risk: The material may not be aluminum, or may be a lower-grade alloy or coated steel masquerading as aluminum.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the edge or cross-section of the sheet, showing the material thickness and composition, ideally with a magnet test (steel will attract a magnet, aluminum will not).
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly steel or low-grade alloy, which would be cheaper than pure aluminum roofing.

risks.risk: The finish may be peeling, chipping, or not durable, especially on the textured surface.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the textured surface under bright light, showing any signs of flaking, cracking, or uneven coating.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially lower quality or with reduced lifespan, affecting value.

risks.risk: The sheet may be cut or damaged at the edges or ends, not visible in the current photos.
risks.proof: A full-length side view showing the entire edge and end of the sheet, including any cuts, bends, or imperfections.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged or not full length, reducing value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the edge or cross-section of the sheet to verify material (aluminum vs steel).
Close-up of the textured surface under bright light to check for coating integrity.
Full-length side view of the sheet to check for damage or cuts.
A shot showing any physical branding or label on the sheet, if present.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an aluminum roofing sheet by type, but the brand and model cannot be confirmed. The seller's claims about 'Capital aluminum' and 'metcopo design' are unverified or unverifiable from the photos. Key risks regarding material authenticity and surface quality cannot be assessed without additional close-up shots. Therefore, a price cannot be determined without further proof.
